Since 2011, Gregory FARAUT is with the Dept. of Mechanical Engineering of ENS Paris-Saclay, University of Paris-Saclay (France). He is currently involved in the teaching of the following courses at graduate levels.

My teaching duty is currently about 320h/year (face-to-face with students) 



## Teaching responsibilities

<!-- Une ligne par responsabilité, la plus récente en haut. -->
- Head of the Master's programme in Complex Systems Engineering (mention ISC), Université Paris-Saclay — coordination of the M1 and M2 tracks of CentraleSupélec, Université d'Évry and ENS Paris-Saclay, since 2024
- Head of the M2 AMSS (Industry of the Future and Intelligent Systems), Université Paris-Saclay, 2020–2024
- Head of the automation teaching platform, Department of Mechanical Engineering, ENS Paris-Saclay, 2014–2020
- Head of internships, Department of Mechanical Engineering, ENS Paris-Saclay, 2012–2019
